title: The Mask Slips
text:
*Goran's mask slips. For just a moment, you see the real man beneath — cold, furious, and dangerous. Then the mask returns, and he smiles.*

Goran: "Poison? Weapons? What colorful accusations. And who, exactly, will believe a wandering stranger over the Duke's own steward?"

*He rings a bell. Two guards appear — his guards.*

Goran: "Escort this person from the estate. They are not welcome here again."

*As you're led out, Goran calls after you.*

Goran: "A word of advice, stranger. Leave Ashenmoor. Tonight. The air here is... unhealthy for outsiders."

*The threat is clear. You've made a powerful enemy. But you've also confirmed everything — Goran is guilty, and he knows you know. The clock is ticking now.*

choices.text: Return to your allies — confrontation has changed nothing
